+    def test_list_status_filters_all_matches_in_normal_order_without_writing(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.cli("list-status", "--status", "pending"), [])
+        self.assertFalse(self.store.path.exists())
+        pending = self.cli("create", "--title", "Pending", "--description", "",
+                           "--priority", "HIGH")
+        completed = self.cli("create", "--title", "Completed", "--description", "",
+                             "--priority", "LOW")
+        other_pending = self.cli("create", "--title", "Also pending", "--description", "",
+                                 "--priority", "CRITICAL")
+        other_completed = self.cli("create", "--title", "Also completed", "--description", "",
+                                   "--priority", "HIGH")
+        self.assertEqual(self.cli("list-status", "--status", "completed"), [])
+        self.cli("complete", "--id", completed["id"])
+        self.cli("complete", "--id", other_completed["id"])
+        self.store.save(list(reversed(self.store.load())))
